answer: Each agent identity must burn a proof-of-work puzzle whose difficulty rides a copper-pin curve of the existing population, then post a non-transferable bond. Honest agents pay this once; a Sybil farm pays it per puppet, cannot resell tickets, and loses each bond when one clone is caught. The kernel of the cost is that identity N+1 costs more than N, so farming N votes exceeds N times one admission. Clones funded together form a visible dune of correlated tickets, so peers can slash the whole set at once.
